jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Management, Technical
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you energized by defining product strategy in ambiguous spaces and building teams that deliver meaningful results at scale? We are looking for a Senior Manager, Product Management - Technical to lead a product management organization at Amazon. In this role, you will own the strategic vision and multi-year roadmap for a product portfolio that directly impacts how customers experience Amazon's technology. You will set direction in environments where the problem and opportunity may not yet be fully defined, translating complex inputs from customers and stakeholders into a clear, actionable product strategy. Your work will span system design, roadmap prioritization, and cross-functional alignment — all while building and developing a high-performing team of product managers and leaders.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define and communicate the long-term product vision and strategy for your portfolio, working backward from customer needs to identify problems worth solving and aligning your roadmap to organizational goals.
* Lead, coach, and grow a team of product managers and people leaders, setting the standard for talent development, onboarding, and performance management across your organization.
* Drive clarity in ambiguous problem spaces by decomposing complex challenges into actionable plans, distinguishing reversible from irreversible decisions, and making informed trade-offs across opportunity, resources, and sustainability.
* Partner with engineering, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver scalable technical solutions, integrating generative AI and emerging technologies where they accelerate customer value.
* Establish mechanisms to inspect product quality, operational performance, and customer experience, using data to continuously improve outcomes and communicate progress to senior leadership.

  
A day in the life  
You start your morning reviewing a product narrative ahead of a leadership review, sharpening the strategy with your team before presenting to senior stakeholders. Mid-morning, you join a roadmap prioritization session with engineering and science partners, working through trade-offs on upcoming launches. After lunch, you hold a one-on-one with a direct report to discuss their career growth and coach them through a challenging stakeholder alignment. Later, you evaluate a proof-of-concept for a new AI-driven feature, assessing feasibility and customer impact before wrapping up with a cross-team sync to unblock a dependency.  
  
About the team  
Our team builds technology products that serve Amazon customers at scale. We operate in a collaborative, inclusive environment where product leaders are empowered to define strategy, experiment with new approaches, and drive meaningful business outcomes. We value thoughtful debate, clear written communication, and a genuine commitment to growing the people around us. We are focused on solving complex problems through innovation and are investing in areas like intelligent automation and generative AI to shape the future of our products. If you are excited about building both great products and great teams, we would love to hear from you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 6+ years of team management experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience delivering consumer software products and services in a high growth environment

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

---------------

Join Amazon Business — a multi-billion global B2B marketplace — and lead the product strategy that powers how the world's largest enterprises manage their procurement accounts. As a Sr. PMT on the Amazon Business Foundational Services team, you'll build the enterprise-grade capabilities that enable Fortune 500 and Global 2000 companies to onboard, govern, and procure across countries, currencies, and compliance regimes.  
  

* Own 0-to-1 product launches that directly impact how multinational organizations adopt Amazon Business
* Define the multi-year roadmap for Business Account Management — one of the highest-visibility charters in AB
* Partner with engineering to architect scalable, secure, globally distributed systems
* Work backwards from C-suite procurement leaders, IT admins, and end-users at the world's biggest companies
* Operate in a fast-moving startup environment backed by Amazon's scale, data, and infrastructure

  
About Amazon Business  
Come be a part of a rapidly expanding multi-billion-dollar global business. At Amazon Business, a fast-growing startup passionate about building solutions, we set out every day to innovate and disrupt the status quo. We stand at the intersection of tech & retail in the B2B space developing innovative purchasing and procurement solutions to help businesses and organizations thrive. At Amazon Business, we strive to be the most recognized and preferred strategic partner for smart business buying. Bring your insight, imagination and a healthy disregard for the impossible. Join us in building and celebrating the value of Amazon Business to buyers of all sizes and industries.

We are looking for a high-performing Senior Product Manager – Technical to own and drive the product strategy for enterprise-ready Business Account Management capabilities, with a focus on enabling large multinational organizations to seamlessly adopt and scale Amazon Business across their global operations.  
In this role, you will work backwards from the needs of enterprise procurement leaders, IT administrators, and end-users at Fortune 500 and Global 2000 companies to define, build, and launch capabilities that simplify account onboarding, user governance, organizational hierarchy management, and cross-border account administration. You will build AI and agentic solutions to automate account configuration, administration tasks, and intelligent onboarding workflows for enterprise customers. You will partner closely with engineering, UX, sales, and business development teams to deliver scalable solutions that meet the complex requirements of multinational enterprises — including SSO/SAML integration, multi-entity account structures, delegated administration, compliance controls, and global account consolidation.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Product Strategy & Vision: Define the product vision and multi-year roadmap for enterprise Business Account Management capabilities, aligning with Amazon Business’s global growth strategy for large multinational customers.
* Work Backwards from the Customer: Deeply understand the needs of enterprise procurement, IT, and finance stakeholders at large multinational organizations; translate those needs into clear product requirements and user stories.
* Enterprise-Ready Capabilities: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for features such as multi-entity account hierarchies, cross-border account management, SSO/identity federation, delegated admin controls, bulk user provisioning, and compliance/governance frameworks.

* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Sales, Business Development, Legal, and Compliance teams to ensure product capabilities meet the regulatory and operational requirements of multinational enterprises across diverse markets.
* Data-Driven Decision Making: Define and track success metrics; retrieve and analyze feedback from customers, stakeholders, and partner teams to shape requirements and prioritize the roadmap.
* Innovation: Identify new opportunities to innovate on behalf of enterprise customers; deliver innovative, simple solutions that impact thousands of business customers globally.

  
A day in the life  
You will define and prioritize the product roadmap for enterprise account management, writing requirements and leading sprint planning with engineering. Day-to-day, you'll conduct customer discovery calls with Fortune 500 procurement leaders and IT administrators, analyze account onboarding and adoption metrics, and author product artifacts to align stakeholders and leadership. You'll partner with Sales, Business Development, UX, and Legal stakeholders to unblock enterprise deals and resolve complex multi-country account configuration challenges. Core problems include simplifying multinational account hierarchies, scaling identity federation, and reducing enterprise onboarding friction.

We are committed to attracting and selecting the very best people to join our team and to creating a workplace that promotes individual career growth; we value our people and their well-being. The group employs over 210 people from over 27 countries around the world with Assets Under Management and Administration of over 3 billion.

Working in a fast-moving and cross-functional environment, we are looking for solid experience in owning and guiding the design and delivery of products and services as well as team leadership background. **Description**
The Sr. Product Manager-Tech on the DSP-DA LifeCycle Management (DALCM) team owns the end-to-end product strategy and execution for the critical milestones in the Delivery Service Partner (DSP) Delivery Associate (DA) lifecycle, including onboarding, off-boarding, qualifications management, and status management across Amazon's global transportation network. The DSP program is the backbone of Amazon's last-mile delivery network, operating in 22 countries with over 4,400 DSPs and 390,000+ Delivery Associates.
  
  
This role is responsible for customer experiences with considerable complexity, managing a unified data platform that serves as the single source of truth for associate information. This includes ownership of multiple concurrent product workstreams — DSP DA onboarding/off-boarding workflow, DSP onboarding/off-boarding experience, employment classification models, qualifications management, and DA data/metadata services — each requiring distinct technical approaches and stakeholder alignment. The Sr. Product Manager-Tech is responsible for driving strategic goals that span multi-million dollar cost savings, DSP satisfaction (CSAT), and DA sentiment — influencing the DA experience from the very first interaction with Amazon's systems. You will own the financial entitlement for your product area and be accountable for measurable improvements in onboarding speed, compliance automation, and operational efficiency for DSPs worldwide.
  
  
We are in the early stages of a multi-year initiative to overhaul much of the DA lifecycle experience from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity to invent and simplify at scale — redesigning foundational systems and workflows that touch hundreds of thousands of drivers globally. The role comes with significant investment backing and outsized influence in shaping what the next-generation experience looks like.
  
  
This is a global role requiring cross-regional coordination across all regions where the DSP program is established or will be established, each with distinct compliance requirements, legal frameworks, hiring models, and payment structures. The role requires distinguishing between one-way and two-way door decisions to drive rapid experimentation where possible while ensuring appropriate rigor for irreversible choices. The Sr. Product Manager-Tech serves as Voice of the Customer by generalizing requirements from diverse DSP DA personas across regions and use cases — working backward from their needs to reduce friction and time spent in onboarding and offboarding phases. Through direct engagement with DSPs, analysis of support tickets, and monitoring of operational health post-launch, the Sr. Product Manager-Tech gains insight that distinguishes between surface-level requests and underlying problems that truly matter. The Sr. Product Manager-Tech regularly drives product discussions with senior managers and Directors, producing clear documentation and contributing to OP1/OP2 planning cycles.
  
  
We are seeking a PM with expertise and high judgment to determine the right goals, design long-term solutions, and take the lead on initiatives independently while seeking direction when needed. This role operates in a space where problems, opportunities, and strategy are not always clearly defined, and the right candidate will thrive in that ambiguity.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

AbhiBus is a leading online bus-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4,000 bus operators - including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3.5 lakh (350,000+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings.

AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India’s leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms - ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus.

**Job Description**

You’ll own one or more parts of the traveller journey across app and web; we’ll set the exact charter with you. Work on our roadmap includes:

Search and booking — comparing buses, smarter filters, a cleaner seat layout and fewer payment drop-offs.

The trip — an AI-powered Trip Mode, live tracking, delay alerts and boarding-point guidance.

Cancellations and refunds — alternatives before a cancel, clear refund tracking and easy reschedules.

Growth and monetisation — rewards and referrals, cross-sell and upsell, and supply-side monetisation through operator ads and sponsored listings.

**What you’ll do**

Own outcomes — set the roadmap and KPIs for your area, and own the results.

Find the real problem — talk to travellers, bus operators, sales and on-ground teams and support, and keep asking why until you reach the root cause.

Design the experience — sketch and prototype, and work with designers to craft “aha” moments and delightful nudges.

Build with AI — prototype faster, and turn manual, support-heavy journeys into self-serve ones.

Let data decide — pull your own data, run A/B tests and challenge assumptions.

Ship end to end — write clear specs, launch smoothly, keep improving, and keep engineering, design and business aligned.

**What success looks like**

Measurable gains in your metrics — conversion, repeat bookings, app ratings, fewer support contacts.

Superlative experiences, with clear “aha” moments and delightful nudges that travellers notice.

At least one manual journey made self-serve with AI.

**Who you are**

A PM who thinks like a designer and notices friction others miss.

Deeply empathetic — you feel the traveller’s worries before you design for them.

A design thinker who frames the problem before jumping to a solution, and tests early with real users.

Comfortable with data and AI tools, a clear communicator, and high on ownership.

**Qualifications**

1. 2–4 years of product management experience on customer-facing (B2C) app or web products.
2. A track record of shipping features end to end and moving a metric you can name.
3. Hands-on SQL and analytics — funnels, cohorts, A/B tests (tools like Mixpanel, CleverTap, GA or similar).
4. Practical use of AI tools in product work — e.g. ChatGPT or Claude for research and specs, and Figma AI, Lovable, Cursor or similar for prototyping.
5. Hands-on with design thinking and user research — interviews, usability tests, journey mapping — and able to create wireframes and clickable prototypes in Figma or similar tools.
6. Clear written and verbal communication.

**Strongly preferred**

A UX, UI or product design background. Please include a portfolio if you have one.

An MBA from a reputed business school.

**Good to have**

Experience in travel, mobility, e-commerce, payments or marketplaces.

Experience with conversational AI, offers or loyalty products.

**Additional Information**

Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

**Job Description**
Thousands of UK accountancy practices rely on our software every day to run their firms, serve their clients and meet their compliance obligations. As Product Manager, you will own part of that portfolio and help take it from a set of well-run products to a connected, AI-enabled platform that practices and partners can build on. This is a build-and-converge mandate, not a maintenance role.
  
  
The Product Manager role is changing. AI is changing the way we work: the time from idea to working software is shrinking, prototyping is moving towards real development with tools like Claude Code, and the lines between product, engineering and design are blurring. The successful candidate will be flexible and willing to lean into that change, and will partner heavily with engineering and design, shaping, prototyping and building alongside them rather than handing over documents.
  
  
You will use the latest AI tools to move from idea to validated prototype faster than traditional product management allows, in a team that treats AI as part of its everyday toolkit.
  
  
**The Opportunity**

* Practices are consolidating fragmented point tools into one connected workflow and want a single partner to deliver it.
* Clients expect a modern, mobile, trustworthy way to share documents and receive finished work.
* Document data extraction, preparation and review are going AI-native, and practices are adopting agentic tools now.
* Practices increasingly want open APIs, so their own portals, data and reporting stay connected as the market converges.
* Regulatory change, such as Making Tax Digital, keeps raising the bar for reliability at filing peaks.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the product vision and roadmap. Balance customer needs, regulatory change and commercial priorities into a clear, evidence-based plan, and own the commercially consequential decisions that follow from it.
* Deliver the portfolio, season over season. Own your products end to end, at the reliability and scale that filing deadlines and compliance peaks demand.
* Converge products without disrupting customers. Bring overlapping products and capabilities together into one connected experience for every practice and client, and migrate existing customers without breaking what they rely on.
* Componentise the portfolio. Turn each part of the product into reusable workflow components that can be recomposed across the practice workflow and the wider platform, rather than locked inside a single application.
* Open the platform through APIs and orchestration. Expand the API surface (open APIs, events and integrations) as a first-class capability, so practices and partners embed our products in their own portals and workflows, and AI agents and partner systems can coordinate work programmatically.
* Bring agentic, AI-driven workflows to practices. Work with the platform team to bring AI-driven extraction, preparation and review into the product experience, so more of the work shifts from practice staff to the platform while the practice stays in control.
* Turn customer problems into well-defined solutions. Use AI tools to turn customer problems into clear, testable requirements that engineering and design can build from with confidence, in whatever form works best for the team.
* Prototype early, then build. Use Claude Code or similar tools to build working prototypes that test ideas with customers and stakeholders before significant engineering investment is made, and increasingly contribute real, reviewed code alongside engineering.
* Partner heavily with engineering and design. Work side by side with engineers and designers, often shaping ideas together in prototypes and in the build itself, to prioritise the backlog, clarify requirements and remove blockers, so valuable releases reach customers predictably.
* Listen to customers and use data to decide. Run discovery with accountants and practice staff, work with large practices as design partners, and use usage analytics and support insight to measure whether what we ship delivers real outcomes.
* Keep stakeholders informed and aligned. Communicate progress, trade-offs and decisions clearly to senior leaders, sales, support and customer-facing teams.
* Raise the team's AI capability. Share effective prompts, skills, workflows and lessons learned so that AI-assisted product practice becomes the norm across the team.

What success looks like
  
  

* Practices experience one connected workflow, whatever mix of products they run today.
* Our APIs are something practices and partners actively build on, not a bespoke integration project.
* Practices reach AI-driven, agentic preparation and review through our products, season over season.
* Clients get a simpler, faster, more trustworthy experience, and practices see measurably less manual work.
* Releases land predictably, and roadmap decisions are backed by customer evidence and usage data.
* Colleagues across the team are using AI-assisted ways of working because you showed them how.

**Required Qualifications**
Education and experience
  
  

* Degree or equivalent practical experience.

* Demonstrable experience turning customer problems into clear requirements and acceptance criteria that engineering teams can deliver against.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
  
  
With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different - in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
  
  
Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
  
  
Alter Domus Intelligence (ADI) is our next-generation, AI-native platform: a single, cross-asset front end for our clients and their investors that replaces fragmented legacy portals with one coherent, trusted experience. ADI’s first use cases go live in October 2026, and the platform is now building toward a much broader product vision across the entire client and investor journey.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own two foundational layers of ADI: the ADI Platform — the technical and product foundation on which every ADI squad builds — and the Global Master Data Management (GMDM) / Entity Master capability, which is the single mastered entity layer that every squad in the programme depends on.
  
  
ADI is a micro front-end (MFE) architecture: a common shell (authentication, navigation, notifications, search, component library, home and admin pages) into which independent squads — Investor, Payments, Fund of Funds, Reporting and others — plug their surfaces. GMDM sits beneath all of them: it is the single canonical source of truth for Clients, Investors, Funds, Vendors and related parties across the entire enterprise — the foundation without which no squad can correctly identify, secure, or display its data.
  
  
You are not building features for end users directly — you are building the products that enable every other product team. Your customers are internal squads and their engineers, and your success is measured by their velocity, consistency, and ability to ship. At the same time, you own capabilities that are end-user facing and mission-critical: authentication and access control, the home experience, notifications, universal search, the shared component library, and the Entity Master admin experience. You must hold both platforms to the same rigour as any customer-facing product — with performance, availability, security, data quality and developer experience treated as first-class requirements.
  
  
You will work hands-on: authoring executable PRDs, building the first prototypes yourself, and partnering tightly with engineering, architecture, and the other product managers across the ADI programme.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
Platform vision, strategy & roadmap
  
  

* Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for the ADI Platform — the MFE shell, authentication and authorisation layer, shared component library, notifications engine, universal search, and all cross-cutting platform capabilities.
* Define and maintain a clear boundary between what the Platform owns and what belongs to feature squads — resolving ambiguity at pace and with authority, so no squad is ever blocked by an unclear ownership question.
* Prioritise the platform backlog against squad-enablement velocity, non-functional requirements, technical debt, and programme-level delivery commitments.
* Act as the product authority for the platform, making the decisions that trade off between feature-squad needs and platform coherence.

Developer experience & internal product
  
  

* Treat the other ADI squads as your primary customers — understand their dependency needs, pain points and roadmap commitments, and design the platform to enable them rather than constrain them.
* Own the golden-path developer experience: template projects, the shared NPM component library (Photon), CI/CD patterns, MFE composition standards, and deployment infrastructure — ensuring every squad has a well-lit path to building and shipping.
* Establish and govern the standards and contracts between the platform and squad microsites — import maps, API standards, component versioning, and token enrichment — so the platform can evolve without breaking consumers.
* Work alongside the other product managers to help their teams onboard to, and correctly consume, platform capabilities.

Authentication, authorisation & multi-tenancy
  
  

* Own the end-to-end authentication and authorisation product: integration with CIAM and GSP, role-based access control (RBAC), UI component-level authorisation patterns, token enrichment, and the multi-tenancy and client-isolation model.
* Define the access model clearly — who can see what, in which context, for which client or fund — and ensure it is implemented consistently across every squad’s surface.
* Own org context switching, user account management (/account), and the admin experience (/admin).

Core platform experiences
  
  

* Own the ADI home page — including the customisable widget framework (calendar views, user-based preferences) — and ensure it serves as a coherent, high-value landing experience for all user personas.
* Own universal search across ADI — defining scope, relevance, and the integration model with squad-specific content — in alignment with the AI-unified search strategy.
* Own the notifications engine — defining the notification taxonomy, routing logic, SLA and priority model, and the interfaces through which feature squads publish notifications — and partner with the squads (e.g. Fund of Funds, Payments) who consume it.

You must possess a deep understanding of business domains alongside a strong technical grounding in Artificial Intelligence, Large Language Models (LLMs), and autonomous agent workflows. jobs.description:
Job Description

**Who we are looking for:**

This dynamic role which requires good understanding of equities, fixed income, Securities Lending and borrowing business, collateral management.

The business requires constant interaction with multiple stakeholders namely Trading Desk, Borrowers, Internal teams

  

The major responsibilities will be:

Returns booking and exception monitoring the settlement of market loan and return transactions, as well as, ensuring that collateral is appropriately managed daily. This also includes the following:

  

1. Returns processing and email management

2. Collateral Management

3. Fails Management

4. Cash and Non-Cash specific processing

  

**Why this role is important to us:**

The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Global Markets (SSGM). When owners and managers of institutional assets need research, trading, securities lending and innovative portfolio strategies, they turn to SSGM business unit. As our investment research and trading arm, SSGM’s number one goal is to enhance and preserve our clients’ portfolio values by applying technology, optimizing trading, and linking asset classes and markets across the world.

Join us if making your mark in the capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

  

**What you will be responsible for:**

As an Associate Perform several or all the following duties based on assigned desk (domestic, international) and/or product(s):

  

· Processes high volume of international loans, Recall returns, Equilend & Non-Equilend Broker Returns daily adhering to established procedures and controls; monitors and resolves pending and failing aged Returns.

· Interacts with traders, client management, fund group(s) and counterparts regarding discrepancies if any

· Executes instructions to receive or deliver securities from counterparties.

· Confirms end of day re-pricing and money movements with counterparts.

· Reviews contract compare records, DDA’s to validate positions with each counterparty.

· Assists business area with inquiries pertaining to transactional activity; coordinates response with traders, corporate actions staff and other internal teams.

· Ensure timely resolution of counterparty issues including pricing problems, quantities of loans and borrows, etc. while keeping management informed of any potential issues.

· Identifies and analyzes operations risks related to current and potential business and recommends procedural changes/improvements as needed

  

**What we value:**

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

  

· Strong knowledge of Agency/Principle Security lending business, Capital markets and Equities

· Strong communication, interpersonal, organizational, and time management skills

· Deadline and detail oriented

· Demonstrated computer proficiency, including advanced knowledge of MS Excel, as well as problem solving and analytical skills

· Should be flexible to work in US/UK shifts (depends upon requirement)

  

**Shift Timing:**

6:00 PM – 3:00 AM IST/2:00 PM – 11:00PM (Rotational)

  

· **Work Location:**

Hyderabad

  

**Work Experience:**  
1 to 3 years

  

**Education & Preferred Qualifications:**

jobs.title: Full-Stack Python Developer (FastAPI + React + Automation) – GST SaaS Platform
jobs.description:
**Company:** Nylun Global Private Limited  
**Product:** GST Software, a GST compliance and business software (SaaS) for businesses and CA firms  
**Location:** Hyderabad (work from office)  
**Experience:** 2–3 years  
**Salary:** ₹3,00,000 – ₹6,00,000 per annum (based on skills and experience)  
**Employment type:** Full-time, permanent

**About us**

Nylun Global Private Limited is building **GST Software**, a GST compliance and business software for businesses and Chartered Accountant firms across India.

**Where we are today:** the core modules are built as an advanced working prototype. We are now building the **cloud SaaS platform**:

* a modern **React** web app
* a **FastAPI** backend
* a **PostgreSQL** database
* a small, secure **Windows agent** that connects to the cloud and runs automated tasks on the customer’s own computer

More products will follow, including audit and accounting software.

This is the best stage to join: you will help build a SaaS product from the ground up and see it go live.

**Who we are looking for**

We want a young, energetic, hands-on developer who is:

* **hungry for an opportunity** to prove themselves on a real product, not just maintain old code
* **ambitious to grow** with a fast-growing company and take on bigger responsibility
* **passionate about technology, automation and AI**, always learning new tools and better ways of working
* **an owner**, who takes responsibility for results, not only tasks
* **a team player**, happy to help and guide interns and freshers

If you have the skills and the fire to grow, and you want a place where your work is seen, valued and rewarded, this role is for you.

**What you will do**

* **Build the SaaS backend in FastAPI:** a modular monolith with clean REST APIs and OpenAPI documentation.
* **Build the React frontend** (Vite): fast, clean and easy-to-use screens, reports and dashboards.
* **Design PostgreSQL databases:** good data models, efficient queries and indexing for large data.
* **Build a multi-tenant system:** each customer’s data kept separate, with user roles and permissions, secure login and sessions.
* **Background jobs with Redis:** queues for long-running tasks such as imports, processing and report generation.
* **File storage:** store and serve documents and data files using S3-compatible object storage.
* **Build the Windows agent:** a Python tray application that connects securely to the cloud over WebSockets, receives jobs and sends back results.
* **Browser automation** with Selenium or Playwright:
* reliable automation of multi-step web workflows, with proper handling of sessions, timeouts, errors and retries
* always secure, and respecting each website’s rules
* **Packaging and updates:** build Windows installers for the agent and support automatic updates.
* **Admin and internal tools:** an operations admin panel for support, subscriptions and monitoring.
* **Quality:** automated tests (pytest), proper error handling, logging, code reviews, clean Git practice.
* **Use AI every day:** AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot, to build faster, with the judgement to check and correct AI-generated code.
* **Work with our Chartered Accountants** to turn business requirements into accurate, working features.
* **Help guide interns and freshers** on daily tasks and code.

**Must-have skills**

* 2–3 years of hands-on software development experience.
* **Strong Python with FastAPI.** Experience with Flask or Django also counts.
* **React** (with JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS).
* **PostgreSQL:** good SQL, table design, joins, indexes.
* **REST API design:** authentication (JWT/sessions), validation, error handling.
* **Browser automation:** hands-on experience with Selenium or Playwright.
* **Git**, and writing clean, readable code.
* **AI-first working:** daily use of AI coding tools, with real examples of how it helped you deliver faster.
* Good communication in English. Telugu or Hindi is a plus.

**Strong plus**

* Redis, and background job queues (Celery, RQ, ARQ, RabbitMQ or similar).
* WebSockets and async Python (asyncio).
* Multi-tenant SaaS: customer-level data separation, roles and permissions.
* Windows desktop or tray apps, and packaging Python apps (PyInstaller, Nuitka, Inno Setup, MSI).
* Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), deployment to Linux, AWS, Azure or GCP.
* Automated testing with pytest.
* S3 or other object storage.

**Good to have**

* GST, accounting, tax or fintech software experience.
* Payment gateway integration (Razorpay), email and SMS services, Google sign-in (OAuth).
* Vite, React Query, Tailwind CSS or similar modern frontend tools.
* Node.js or another backend language.

**No GST knowledge? No problem.** Our Chartered Accountants will train you. We value strong engineering skills, attitude and willingness to learn.

**What we are NOT looking for**

* Someone looking only for a comfortable, routine job.
* Someone who copies AI-generated code without understanding or checking it.
* Someone who builds automation that works once and breaks often.
* Someone who wants to restart everything from scratch. We build carefully on the work already done.

**Why join Nylun Global Private Limited**

* **Build a SaaS product from the ground up** and see your work go live with businesses and CA firms across India.
* **A real opportunity to prove yourself:** your work directly shapes the product.
* **Fast growth:** a clear path to Senior Developer and Lead roles for people who perform.
* **Modern stack:** FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, WebSockets, automation, cloud and AI tools.
* **AI-first culture:** work the way modern engineering teams work.
* **Learning:** learn GST and fintech from experienced Chartered Accountants.
* **Work directly with the founders**, not through layers of management.
* **Competitive salary:** ₹3–6 lakh per annum based on skills and experience, with performance-based growth.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

**Accessibility Testing Expert**  
**Job ID#:26-2235**  
**Clearance: Not Required**  
**Location: Hyderabad/Vijayawada**  
  
**Who We Are**:  
Since our inception back in 2006, Navitas has grown to be an industry leader in the digital transformation space, and we’ve served as trusted advisors supporting our client base within the commercial, federal, and state and local markets.  
  
**What We Do**:  
At our very core, we’re a group of problem solvers providing our award-winning technology solutions to drive digital acceleration for our customers! With proven solutions, award-winning technologies, and a team of expert problem solvers, Navitas has consistently empowered customers to use technology as a competitive advantage and deliver cutting-edge transformative solutions.  
  
**What You’ll Do**:  
We are seeking an experienced Accessibility Testing Expert to provide advanced expertise in evaluating the accessibility and usability of digital products, applications, and content.
  
This role serves as a subject matter expert in digital accessibility and is responsible for conducting comprehensive accessibility assessments, identifying barriers that may impact people with disabilities, evaluating conformance with applicable accessibility standards, and providing clear, actionable guidance to support remediation.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in WCAG standards, assistive technologies, manual accessibility testing, accessibility testing tools, and accessible design and development practices. This individual must be able to evaluate accessibility beyond automated testing, understand the real-world impact of accessibility barriers, and translate complex technical findings into practical recommendations for technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  
  
The Accessibility Testing Expert will collaborate with developers, designers, quality assurance teams, product owners, vendors, and organizational stakeholders to integrate accessibility throughout the digital product lifecycle and support informed accessibility and compliance decisions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead comprehensive accessibility evaluations of websites, applications, and digital content to assess conformance with WCAG 2.0, 2.1, and 2.2 standards and identify barriers that may impact users with disabilities.
* Apply automated testing tools, assistive technologies, manual testing techniques, code inspection, and accessibility tree analysis to identify and validate accessibility barriers.
* Assess the severity, user impact, and accessibility risk of identified issues to support remediation prioritization and informed decision-making.
* Collaborate with developers, designers, QA, and product teams to provide clear remediation guidance, accessibility acceptance criteria, and recommendations that support accessible implementation.
* Validate accessibility remediation across iterative development cycles and confirm that identified barriers have been effectively resolved.
* Participate proactively in design and development reviews to identify accessibility risks early and embed accessibility throughout the product lifecycle.
* Review VPATs and Accessibility Conformance Reports (ACRs) and identify accessibility risks or gaps requiring further evaluation.
* Communicate accessibility findings, risks, priorities, and recommended remediation strategies to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Support accessibility evaluations during procurement, implementation, and third-party vendor reviews.
* Conduct accessibility evaluations of electronic documents, including PDF, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel, against applicable WCAG, Section 508, and PDF/UA requirements.
* Validate document remediation to ensure content is correctly structured and usable with screen readers, keyboard navigation, and other assistive technologies.
* Contribute to organizational accessibility standards, testing methodologies, procedures, reusable best practices, training, and awareness initiatives.

**Required Skills**

* Advanced knowledge of WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 Level A and AA, Section 508, applicable ADA accessibility requirements, and familiarity with WCAG 2.0 for legacy content.
* Extensive hands-on experience testing with JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver, and TalkBack.
* Proficiency with Axe DevTools, Accessibility Insights, WAVE, Color Contrast Analyzer, Acrobat Pro, and other accessibility testing tools.
* Strong working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, semantic HTML, ARIA, WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices, and browser accessibility trees.
* Expertise in comprehensive manual and automated accessibility testing, including keyboard, screen reader, focus management, contrast, zoom/reflow, text spacing, and dynamic-content testing.
* Experience evaluating and remediating PDF, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel documents, including knowledge of PDF/UA.
* Experience reviewing VPATs/ACRs and assessing accessibility risk.
* Ability to map findings accurately to WCAG criteria, severity, and user impact and provide actionable remediation guidance.
* Strong analytical, technical documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to explain accessibility requirements to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple accessibility assessments and collaborate effectively across development, design, QA, product, and business teams.

  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field preferred.
* At least 8 years of professional experience performing accessibility testing and audits in web and mobile applications.
* Trusted Tester Certification issued by DHS or a similar certification in accessibility is preferred.

*The salary range listed reflects our standard market pay structure. Final compensation will be determined based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, the candidate’s unique qualifications, skills required for the position, professional experience, education, and business needs…

jobs.title: Product Lead - Private Credit (Direct Lending)
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
  
  
Financial technology is a high-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
  
  
Arcesium seeks a Product Lead with deep private credit expertise to build and evolve our Private Credit capabilities. This is an individual contributor role, working closely with Engineering, Client & Partner Development, Sales, and Marketing. The product spans the deal-close and post-close lifecycle, including deal onboarding, portfolio monitoring, covenant and borrowing-base management, loan administration, reporting, and related workflows.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Execute the Private Credit product roadmap, translating product strategy, client needs, and domain knowledge into requirements and prioritized capabilities.
* Own product definition and design, working with Engineering and QA through development, testing, launch, and iteration.
* Work with clients and design partners to validate product direction and translate recurring needs into scalable capabilities.
* Develop business scenarios, test cases, and validation models to ensure the product handles real-world private credit structures and calculations correctly.
* Take new capabilities from prototype through production readiness and broader client adoption.
* Partner with Sales, Pre-Sales, Forward Deployed, and Marketing on positioning, demonstrations, client discussions, and go-to-market.
* Contribute to competitive analysis, business cases, and prioritization of R&D investments.
* Prototype workflows, calculations, and automation using AI-assisted coding and modern development tools.
* Define AI-enabled capabilities for interpreting credit agreements, compliance certificates, borrower reporting, trustee reports, and other private credit documents.

**What You'll Need**

* 5+ years of hands-on private credit experience, with meaningful exposure to the lifecycle, documentation, calculations, and workflows of private credit investments; product management experience is an advantage.
* Strong depth in one or more areas of private credit, with direct lending experience particularly valuable; experience in asset-based finance, structured credit, or adjacent credit strategies is also relevant — spanning unitranche, senior or subordinated lending, delayed-draw facilities, revolvers, asset-based lending, specialty finance, CRE lending, ABS, CLOs, or loan portfolios.
* Working knowledge of covenant monitoring and testing, compliance certificates, breaches, waivers, and amendments; borrowing bases, advance rates, collateral eligibility, concentration limits, and reserves; and loan lifecycle events including drawdowns, paydowns, prepayments, PIK, OID, assignments, and participations.
* Familiarity with cash waterfalls, priority of payments, OC/IC tests, triggers, and portfolio or collateral surveillance.
* Ability to read credit agreements and related reporting and determine what a product needs to capture, calculate, validate, and monitor.
* Strong Excel and financial-modeling skills, including independent validation of covenants, borrowing bases, waterfalls, or similar calculations.
* Ability to work directly with data; SQL experience is strongly preferred, with familiarity in scripting, APIs, or low-code tools an advantage.
* Experience with platforms such as Wall Street Office, Allvue, Solvas, iLEVEL, or similar systems, preferred.
* Experience with generative AI tools for prototyping, or a demonstrated aptitude to use them effectively.
* Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, engineering, computer science, or a related field preferred; CFA, CA, MBA, FRM, or similar qualifications are an advantage.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to explain complex credit concepts clearly.

Arcesium's Personal Data Privacy Notice for Candidates is linked here.
  
  
**Recruiting Security**
Emails from genuine Arcesium recruiters who are employees of the company will always come from the @arcesium.com domain. In some cases, you may also be contacted by independent search firms engaged to recruit on our behalf; emails from their employees should always come from their firm's applicable domain. We'll never ask for your banking information or any payment as part of the recruiting process. If something seems off or you're contacted by an unexpected third party, please reach out to us at careers@arcesium.com (US/UK), careers-india@arcesium.com (India) or careers-europe@arcesium.com (Portugal/Sweden).
  
  
*Arcesium is an equal opportunity employer.*

jobs.title: AS400 Architect
jobs.description:
We are looking for a seasoned **AS/400 Architect** to define the technical vision and architectural direction for the AI Tools team, shaping EPAM's in-house solution for IBM iSeries (AS/400) application reverse engineering, analysis, and modernization at an enterprise scale.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Define the architectural vision, standards, and technical roadmap for the IBM iSeries (AS/400) reverse-engineering and modernization solution
* Conduct application portfolio analysis to identify redundant, unreachable, duplicated, obsolete, tightly coupled, and highly complex code, and assess application quality, maintainability, performance, technical debt, modernization readiness, and potential risks
* Analyze legacy IBM AS/400 applications, identify dependencies and business rules, trace data flows, document application behavior, and assess undocumented or complex codebases
* Drive IBM AS/400 modernization approaches, including code refactoring, format conversion, database modernization, API and web-service enablement, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud integration, re-platforming, and application retirement
* Collaborate with the AI Tools team to define requirements, validate analysis logic, improve prompts and rules, and enhance the accuracy of AI-generated application documentation and code insights
* Architect AI capabilities for program understanding, dependency discovery, business-rule extraction, data-flow analysis, impact analysis, code summarization, test-case generation, and modernization recommendations
* Contribute to technical assessments, proofs of concept, solution demonstrations, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, progress reporting, and executive-level presentations
* Partner with customer IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, modernization specialists, AI Tools team members, testing teams, cloud architects, and Technical Leadership across the client and EPAM organizations
* Ensure that the reverse-engineering and modernization solution complies with enterprise architecture standards, customer security policies, source-code handling requirements, data-protection controls, audit requirements, and applicable regulatory obligations

**Requirements**

* 13+ years of experience in enterprise midrange (iSeries or AS/400) technologies, with 5+ years focused on application analysis, reverse engineering, and modernization solutions
* Expertise in RPG III, RPG IV, and RPGLE, including hands-on development, maintenance, and refactoring of large-scale legacy applications
* Proficiency in free-format RPG, CL/CLLE, and COBOL, with the ability to analyze and convert fixed-format code to modern equivalents
* Skills in DDS, DSPFs, and SQL, including designing, interpreting, and optimizing display files, physical/logical files, and complex queries
* Background in Db2 for i, covering database design, performance tuning, journaling, stored procedures, triggers, and DDS-to-DDL conversion
* Understanding of IBM i architecture, including libraries, objects, service programs, printer files, commitment control, and integrated file systems
* Knowledge of reverse engineering techniques for legacy AS/400 applications, including dependency mapping, business-rule extraction, and data-flow tracing
* Familiarity with modernization strategies such as API enablement, web-service integration, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud migration, and re-platforming
* Competency in application portfolio assessment, technical debt evaluation, code quality analysis, and modernization readiness reviews
* Capability to collaborate with AI Tools teams by defining requirements, validating analysis logic, refining prompts, and improving AI-generated documentation and code insights
* Flexibility to support delivery activities, including proofs of concept, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, and executive-level presentations
* Showcase of strong stakeholder management skills to engage IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, cloud architects, and technical leadership across client and internal organizations
* Qualifications in governance and compliance, ensuring adherence to enterprise architecture standards, security policies, data-protection controls, and regulatory obligations
* Proficiency in English at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Product Manager – Ad Decisioning Enablement**  
  
**Roundel, Target’s Retail Media Network**  
  
**About us**  
  
As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.  
  
**Team Overview**  
  
Roundel is Target’s retail media network, helping brands connect with millions of Target guests through relevant, measurable, and guest-centered advertising experiences.  
  
As retail media continues to grow, advertisers are looking for smarter ways to plan, activate, optimize, and measure their investments. Roundel is investing in next-generation intelligence products that help teams and advertisers make better media decisions across channels, campaign stages, and business objectives.  
  
We are looking for a **Product Manager** to lead a high-impact area focused on **ad-inventory forecasting** and **ad-relevance** capabilities  
  
In this role, you will shape capabilities that enable our ad-decisioning engine elevate customer experience and deliver advertiser outcomes. This is a hands-on product leadership role for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, and building systems that translate complex signals into decision drivers  
  
You will partner closely with data science, engineering, analytics, and product teams to define the strategy, roadmap, and execution for capabilities that help Roundel deliver more effective, and measurable advertising outcomes.  
  
**What you’ll do**

  

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for ad-inventory forecasting and ad-relevance.
* Working at the intersection of data, AI, and business, you’ll partner closely with data scientists, engineers, and partner teams to design scalable systems and intelligent models.
* Collaborate with sales, GTM and other product teams to ensure these products translate into real-world value for advertisers, and to continuously refine based on adoption, performance, and market feedback.
* As part of Roundel, Target’s retail media business, play a pivotal role in advancing the sophistication of our forecasting, optimization, and recommendation engines.
* Influence how advertisers plan, invest, and win on Target’s platform — impacting both advertiser success and Target’s bottom line.

**What we’re looking for**

  

* Experience: 4+ years of Product Management, ideally with a focus on data-driven, optimization, or AI/ML-powered products in adtech, martech, or related fields.
* Technical fluency: Comfortable working with data science, machine learning, experimentation, or AI-driven systems; able to bridge technical depth with business application.
* Domain knowledge: Understanding of retail media networks, digital advertising ecosystems, or media buying workflows is a strong plus.
* Cross-functional leadership: Proven ability to partner with data engineers, scientists, API developers, and commercial teams to bring complex products to market.
* Analytical strength: Skilled at interpreting large datasets, validating accuracy, and turning complex signals into actionable decisions.
* AI curiosity: Experience (or strong interest) in GenAI/agentic AI and applying emerging technologies to improve forecasting, optimization, and recommendations.
* Strategic mindset: Able to set product vision, establish OKRs, and drive execution across multiple dependencies in a fast-moving space.
* Influence & storytelling: Excellent communicator who can distil technical complexity into compelling narratives for sales, advertisers, and executives.
* Organized & adaptable: Adept at managing priorities, navigating ambiguity, and iterating quickly based on feedback and results.
* A bias for action, curiosity, structured problem-solving, and a passion for building products that create measurable impact.

**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Role purpose**

The Business Product Manager will act as the accountable business owner for the BaNCS platform within Entitlements and Trade & Settlements. The role is responsible for defining business strategy, prioritising product development, governing platform change, management of the application and all Data attributes, ensuring operational readiness and maximising business value from platform investments.

The role serves as the primary liaison between Operations, Product Management, Technology, vendors and business stakeholders while ensuring the platform supports strategic modernisation objectives, regulatory obligations, operational efficiency and client service requirements.

**Core responsibilities**

1. Product strategy and roadmap

* Own and maintain the multi-year BaNCS product roadmap.
* Define the platform vision, target state and measurable business outcomes.
* Prioritise demand, enhancements, regulatory change and strategic initiatives.
* Evaluate business cases, benefits, risks, dependencies and investment opportunities.
* Align regional and functional requirements to the enterprise settlements strategy.

2. Platform governance

* Act as Business Application Owner for BaNCS and provide clear business accountability.
* Chair or represent the business in product governance forums and working groups.
* Approve business requirements, operating-model decisions and solution designs within delegated authority.
* Maintain oversight of product risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies and decisions.
* Escalate strategic decisions, delivery risks and control concerns to the appropriate governance body.

3. Requirements and change management

* Gather, challenge, document and prioritise business requirements.
* Translate operational and client needs into clear capabilities, outcomes and acceptance criteria.
* Manage the business backlog and recommend release priorities.
* Review impact assessments, change requests, sequencing options and implementation plans.
* Ensure changes transition successfully into the operating environment.

4. Data and process ownership

* Own or coordinate ownership for the key business processes operating through BaNCS.
* Define data-accountability and stewardship arrangements for critical settlement data.
* Approve business data mappings, static-data requirements and interface requirements.
* Oversee data-quality issues, remediation priorities and governance upkeep.
* Ensure changes to data use are appropriately assessed and governed.

5. Testing and implementation

* Sponsor business testing and secure appropriate operational SME participation.
* Agree UAT scope, test priorities and business acceptance criteria.
* Oversee review of test cases, outcomes, defects and residual risks.
* Coordinate business sign-off for requirements, data, testing and implementation readiness.
* Support go-live, migration, stabilisation and post-implementation review activities.

* Act as the primary business contact across Operations, Product, Technology, change teams and TCS.
* Build alignment across legal entities, regions, processing teams and control functions.
* Manage vendor-related priorities, requirements, costs, dependencies and escalation paths.
* Prepare concise updates for senior stakeholders and governance committees.
* Resolve competing priorities and facilitate timely business decisions.

7. Risk, regulatory and control

* Ensure platform design and change reflect applicable regulatory and operational-control requirements.
* Assess impacts arising from market, legal-entity, client and custody-model change.
* Support audit, risk, compliance, resilience and control assessments.
* Ensure appropriate segregation of duties, access governance and maker-checker controls are reflected in the operating model.
* Maintain traceable approvals, decisions and governance evidence.

8. Financial and portfolio management

* Support annual capital planning and funding submissions for BaNCS initiatives.
* Develop or coordinate business cases with clear scope, outcomes, benefits, risks and resource needs.
* Prioritise investments against strategic, regulatory, risk and operational criteria.
* Track delivery against approved scope, funding and roadmap commitments.
* Monitor benefits realisation and recommend corrective action where expected value is at risk.

Amazon Prime Video's vision is to be the world's favorite entertainment brand and the first-choice entertainment hub globally. Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows, movies and live sports, all in one place where it is easy to find what they love to watch. Members can also subscribe to add-on channels (third-party streaming services) and rent new-release movies on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is at the forefront of the entertainment industry and growing fast, now available in 240 countries and territories worldwide. We work in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do.  
  
As a Senior Product Manager for Prime Video in India, you will own the product strategy and roadmap for one of our largest international markets. You will build a deep understanding of local customers, including how they discover content, choose plans and pay. You will turn those insights into products that grow and retain Prime Video customers. You will define what we build and why, write the documents that earn alignment, and partner with regional business teams and worldwide product and engineering teams to launch and scale features. We are looking for a customer-obsessed product manager with a strong track record of shipping products, using data to make decisions, and leading across teams without direct authority.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Own the multi-year product vision and roadmap for India and other emerging priority countries, and prioritize investments by customer and business impact.  
  
Write PRFAQs, product requirements and business cases that define the customer problem, the solution and the success metrics.  
  
Partner with engineering, UX, science, and the worldwide Payments, Subscriptions, Personalization and App Experience teams to deliver local features on global platforms.  
  
Design and read experiments (weblabs), and use the results to decide what to launch, iterate on or stop.  
  
Build products that fit local needs, such as local payment methods, plans and pricing, partner bundles and local content discovery.  
  
Report progress, risks and results to senior leadership through regular business reviews.

------------------------

* 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Master's degree or equivalent
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products
* Experience leading projects across multiple stakeholders

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**
The Product Manager for AI at GE Vernova plays a crucial role in the development and execution of AI-powered products that transform business processes. This role is essential to our mission of pioneering AI-driven innovation and enhancing user experiences across the enterprise.
  
  
The Product Manager will work with across GE Vernova and with the AI Portfolio Manager to identify, prioritize and build out AI products. These products (several) focus on delivering improvements and value through the lens of the Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) framework, measuring the impact of AI initiatives.
  
  
Additionally, the Product Manager facilitates cross-business coordination, leveraging AI applications to drive operational improvements and foster innovation across Vernova. Expertise in AI, combined with strong business acumen, is pivotal in translating complex technical challenges into strategic opportunities that propel the organization forward. These duties extend to not only internally developed solutions, but also to external suppliers (e.g. 3rd party software).
  
  
As a GE Vernova accelerator, GE Vernova Advanced Research is driving strategy and leading research & development efforts to execute on the business’s mission to help power the energy transition. We forge the collaborations and help invent the technologies required to electrify and decarbonize for a zero-carbon future.
  
  
Representing virtually every major scientific and engineering discipline, our researchers are collaborating with GE Vernova’s businesses, the U.S. government, and more than 420 entities at the forefront of technology to execute on 150+ energy-focused projects. Collectively, these research programs and initiatives aim to solve near term technical challenges, deliver next generation product advances, and drive long term breakthrough innovation to enable more affordable, reliable, sustainable, and secure energy.
  
  
**Job Description**
Key Responsibilities:
  
  

* Product Ownership and Development: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business, engineering, and research, to develop and execute product roadmaps that align with strategic objectives.
* Roadmap input: Provide input, alongside the Portfolio manager, to build the product roadmaps
* Technical Collaboration: Work closely with data scientists, IT, and designers to ensure the development of robust AI solutions, maintaining technical rigor and introducing new methods for verifying success and identifying risks.
* User Experience: Focus on delivering exceptional user experiences by understanding and addressing user needs in AI applications.
* Cross-Business Coordination: Support the coordination of AI applications to drive improvements and innovations across Vernova.
* Data-Driven Decision Making: Utilize data analytics to measure product performance and make informed decisions. Define and monitor metrics and KPIs to ensure the success and impact of AI initiatives.
* Post-Launch Support: Monitor product performance post-launch, gather user feedback, and iterate on product features to enhance value delivery.
* 3rd party solutions: Oversee the interjection of AI products coming from 3rd party software suppliers and determine best technology fit.

**Position Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, with 10+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience with GE/GE Vernova highly preferred.
* Business Acumen: Ability to integrate business strategy with technical initiatives.
* Leadership: Proven leadership in managing cross-functional teams and projects.
* Communication Skills: Excellent communication and presentation skills to engage with diverse stakeholders and occasionally C-Suite executives.
* Experience building and deploying AI applications.
* Problem-Solving Skills: Analytical skills to identify and solve risks and challenges.
* Technical Proficiency and Data-Driven Mindset

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).
* 2 years of experience developing or launching infrastructure products or technologies within networking, storage, compute hardware, databases, file systems, data analytics, cluster management, and other software infrastructure areas.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in product management in the quoting and agreement domain at a cloud provider.
* Experience in managing product backlogs and delivering quality solutions.
* Knowledge of Salesforce Configure Price Quote (CPQ) and related first-party applications.

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

**About The Job**
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information.
